description: Combined form of the Tail read tools: get_doctor_picks, get_doctor_parlays, get_league_order, get_tail_feed, tail_hot, tail_my_posts and get_tail_post (same fields, same answers): version bsd-agent-tail-v1 and one action. Also every other Tail read the app has, on its own routes: timeline: GET tail/timeline params {limit, cursor}; timeline_post: GET tail/timeline/posts/{postId}; own_profile: GET tail/profile; profiles: GET tail/profiles params {prefix, limit, cursor}; profile: GET tail/profiles/{profileId}; profile_record: GET tail/profiles/{profileId}/record; profile_record_v2: GET tail/profiles/{profileId}/record-v2; profile_connections: GET tail/profiles/{profileId}/connections params {direction followers|following, limit, cursor}; relations: GET tail/relations params {kind follow|mute|block, limit, cursor}; search: POST tail/search params {query, category people|posts, limit, cursor}; lists: GET tail/lists params {limit, cursor}; list: GET tail/lists/{listId}; list_members: GET tail/lists/{listId}/members params {limit, cursor}; replies: GET tail/posts/{postId}/replies params {limit, cursor}; reply: GET tail/replies/{replyId}; moments: GET tail/moments params as the app; top: GET tail/top params as the app; top_v2: GET tail/top-v2 params {limit 1-50}; repost_state: GET tail/posts/{postId}/repost; post_grade: GET tail/posts/{postId}/grade; post_analysis: GET tail/posts/{postId}/analysis.

gradeFamily.description: feed and hot: only posts whose letter is in this family.

league.description: doctor_parlays (required) and doctor_picks (optional filter): one league id, e.g. LGUE_nfl.

params.description: The app query (or tail/search body) for timeline, profiles, profile_connections, relations, search, lists, list_members, replies, moments, top, top_v2.

sport.description: doctor_picks only (optional filter): one sport id, e.g. SPRT_americanfootball.

name: tail_read
title: Read Tail
